generation_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production-ready full-sphere equirectangular sky panorama texture for a stylized 3D island game.
Generate a new original SKY TEXTURE ONLY, with a precise 2:1 aspect ratio, ideally 3840 x 1920 pixels or the largest available exact 2:1 resolution. This is not a scene illustration, not a camera photograph and not a landscape vista. It represents every direction around a sphere. The horizontal center line is the horizon; the upper half is the sky hemisphere and the lower half is a simple quiet continuation of pale blue with no physical ground.
Art direction: the restrained shape language and clean color masses of The Witness, with gentle anime-game cloud volume. Fresh, clear, calm, sunny daytime. It will sit behind pale pink flowering trees, coral-orange autumn trees, golden straw grass, yellow-green foliage and stylized anime characters under warm afternoon sunlight.
Sky palette: fresh moderate-saturation cyan-blue (not dark cobalt and not lavender); smooth richer blue toward zenith, fading to very pale cyan-blue at the true horizon. Avoid oversaturated turquoise. Clouds: four to six distinct, widely spaced asymmetric groups of broad horizontally spreading fair-weather cumulus over the full 360 degrees. Large elegant masses with a few rounded bulges, not many tiny cotton balls. Warm ivory-white lit tops, subtle pale cool blue-gray undersides, two or three calm tonal planes, softly modeled but visibly simplified. Mostly crisp readable main silhouettes with a few softened edges. No noisy photographic wisps or brush grain. Let the clouds occupy roughly 20–25% of the upper hemisphere; preserve substantial unbroken blue regions behind tree and architectural silhouettes. Most clouds at low-to-mid elevation, smaller distant clouds sparsely and intermittently near the horizon. Leave the very top clear of clouds to avoid polar stretching.
Technical constraints: correct equirectangular projection, clouds compressed vertically nearer the poles as appropriate for spherical mapping, horizontally seamless wrap with identical left and right edge colors; keep clouds away from the left/right seam so the seam is only smooth sky gradient. Zenith row and nadir row each must be uniform across their width. The lower hemisphere is entirely a simple pale cyan-blue gradient, no clouds and no scenery. A smooth continuous transition across the center horizon with no hard line, no ocean horizon band, no black bottom. Do not draw any sun disk, sun flare, rays, mountains, islands, ocean, water, trees, buildings, birds, characters, objects, typography, border or watermark. No sunset colors, no dramatic storm, no volumetric fog, no fantasy nebula.
Deliver the flat 2:1 panorama itself filling the entire image, without a preview sphere, inset, frame or UI.
palette_edit_prompt:
Edit this sky panorama into its final production texture. Preserve the exact 2:1 equirectangular layout, the horizontal centerline horizon, the large areas of blue sky, and the warm-white simplified cumulus style. Make these targeted improvements:
1. Make the blue fresher and gentler, about 15% less saturated, with a slightly more cyan-blue hue instead of strong cobalt. The intended game has pink flowering trees, orange autumn trees and gold grass; the sky should complement them calmly.
2. Make both the leftmost and rightmost 7% strips completely cloud-free smooth sky gradient. There must be NO cut-off clouds at either image edge. The two edges must match exactly row by row, so this wraps seamlessly around a sphere.
3. Simplify the scattered tiny cloud fragments and streaks. Retain four or five well-separated broad main cloud groups, gently sculpted using two or three tonal planes. Remove the continuous narrow white stripe/cloud wall along the horizon; distant cloud groups must be sparse with visible blue gaps.
4. Keep the exact top row uniform blue across the entire width and the exact bottom row uniform pale blue across the width. No clouds near the zenith. The entire lower half stays simple pale cyan-blue with a very subtle vertical gradient, absolutely no ocean, ground, land or objects.
Do not add a sun, stars, birds, lens flare, text, frames, preview spheres or a landscape. Deliver only the full flat 2:1 texture, ideally at the largest available exact 2:1 resolution.
